method_note: Published lineups snapshot all week and FREEZE at the slate date (the last version you could actually have played). Skill slots score from real box scores with the same DK formula as the projections; a DNP scores 0 -- exactly what your entry would have scored. DST is PARTIAL (points-allowed tier only; no free sacks/turnovers feed) and understates real DST scores by roughly 4-6 points. Scored slates are never edited -- with ONE disclosed exception (2026-10-23): scorer v1 zeroed players whose names carry punctuation or a suffix; those slates were rescored where box scores survive (old totals kept under 'rescored') and retracted where they don't.
disclosures: Fumbles lost / 2-pt conversions are absent from the box feed (~0.1-0.3 pts/slot).
DST actuals are partial (PA tier only) and labeled per-slot.
A projected player with no box row on slate day scores 0 (DNP) -- disclosed per-slot.
Bias compares like for like: a slot with no actual (DST without a final) is excluded from the projected side too (proj_scored).

From 2026-10-23 lineups are built and graded on the CALIBRATED expectation (proj_basis calibrated_v1); earlier slates were graded on the raw model mean (model_raw) and stay on the record under cumulative_by_basis, never averaged with the new basis.
